Terrain for architects, landscape architects and model makers

Ultra detailed terrain model
of any site on Earth.

Digital elevation model up to 20× more detailed than any open source, with a full analysis of the site’s terrain, water, vegetation and climate built in. Frame up to 10 km anywhere in the world and keep working.

  • DEM up to 20× finer
  • Slope, aspect, curvature
  • Flow paths & catchments
  • Flood & sea-level-rise scenarios
  • Land cover & ecosystems
  • Sun & wind by season
  • Buildings, roads, 3D trees
  • and more →

What to do with it

From the real ground to your project

◇
▶ Video · use-designThe model in Rhino with a design on it; your model placed back on the site

Design on the real terrain

Take the relief, water, trees and buildings into Rhino, SketchUp or CAD and design on the actual ground. Import your own model back onto the site — Rhino, SketchUp, glTF, OBJ — and check it against the slope, the water, the sun and the wind.

▤
▣ Image · use-analysisA competition board built from the drawing base

An information model of the site

A complete information model that grounds the whole design process in the site's real constraints: relief, landscape, climate and hydrology. Maps in named layers for Illustrator, GeoTIFF and Shapefile for GIS, ready-made diagrams of water, sun and wind.

▦
▣ Image · use-modelA plywood terrain model and a 3D print

Print it or cut it Beta

A watertight mesh for 3D printing or the plates of a laser-cut model. Scale, sheet thickness, contour step, buildings and streets: everything can be customised to the physical model you are making.

▶ Video · layers-explodeThe model coming apart into its layers: terrain, vegetation, water, climate, built (loop)
An analysis base

Every layer of the site, apart or together

∠

Terrain

Slope, aspect, roughness, curvature, wetness index and BVH; contours at any step, each map on the model or on its own plate.

✲

Vegetation

Every tree and shrub in 3D with height and crown. Land cover on a 1–3 m grid in 9 classes, refined by Ecosystem Plus into 24 habitat types; NDVI and moisture.

≋

Hydrology

Streams, catchments, flooding and waterlogging, river zones from 40 years of satellite water, sea level rise by IPCC scenario.

☀

Climate

Sun hours, radiation and shadows by season; wind shelter and comfort from the local wind climate.

Five looks
Live data

Watch the site behave

▶ Video · live-waterRain on the site, runoff and lakes filling (10–15 s loop)

Live Water

Let it rain: runoff runs downhill, hollows fill into lakes and spill into the next. Click a lake for its volume, depth and time to fill.

▶ Video · live-windStreaks bending around buildings, blue in the lee, red where it speeds up (10–15 s loop)

Live Wind

The season's wind from the local climate record, slowed in the lee of slopes, buildings and trees and speeding up between them.

▶ Video · live-sunLive Sun arcs and real shadows through a summer day (10–15 s loop)

Live Sun

The solstice and equinox arcs around your project and the real shadows of relief, buildings and trees at any date and hour.

Laser cut Beta

A physical model, prepared in the app

Laser cut is in beta: check the files before cutting and tell us what to improve. Every part of the cut can be customised and adapted to the physical model you need: scale, material, contour step, how buildings and streets are made.

  • Plates at your stepThe relief sliced into closed outlines, the next plate scored on top for gluing in register.
  • Scale and sheetPick a scale or a model size and the sheet thickness; the vertical exaggeration follows.
  • Buildings and streetsScored for placement or cut out as openings, on the plate they stand on.
  • Parts sheetBuilding footprints and street pieces laid out, numbered, with their height at scale.
  • Check before you cutSee the stack in 3D, explode it and spread the sheets apart.
  • Files for the cutterLightBurn project, laser PDF for Trotec and Epilog drivers, SVG and DXF.
▶ Video · laser-sheetsThe stack exploding into sheets in the app (loop)

Landscape design tools, right inside URBNZD

Pricing

Pay per site

Sites up to 5 km. Building a site and exploring it is free; credits pay once per site for its downloads, priced by the longest side: Terrain Pro (up to ×20 resolution), every analysis, every format and every layer are included, and your first site up to 1 km each day is free. Credit packs: 10 for $5, 30 for $12, 100 for $30, 200 for $50 — one urbnzd.app account, the same credits in urban:EXPORT, urban:SCAN, urban:STREET and Planimetric. Payments by Paddle. Data

live
  • Elevation DEMNational lidar via Mapterhorn, swisstopo, AHN, IGN, USGS 3DEP… or Copernicus GLO-30 worldwide
  • OrthophotoNational open orthophotos, 0.2–0.5 m (CH, AT, NL, DE parts, FR, ES, US); Sentinel-2, 10 m elsewhere
  • Image archiveSentinel-2 2016 · JRC water record 1984–2021
  • Water 1984–2024JRC Global Surface Water (Landsat)
  • OpenStreetMapBuildings, roofs, roads, water, land use

Resolution

Open DEM is loaded as is. Terrain Pro synthesises terrain up to 20× finer from image shading, land cover and OSM features (large sites are capped at ~3,200 grid nodes per side).

      Rain runoff: particles fall everywhere and run downhill. Flow streams: particles start where flow concentrates, drawing the drainage network as ribbons.

      sheltered · slowopen groundspeeding up
      
    
      Tapered streaks with an arrowhead glide a few metres above the ground with the wind, slowing in the lee of slopes, buildings and trees and curling in their wakes. Colour compares with the open-field wind: blue sheltered and slow, neutral ink on open ground, orange to red where the flow speeds up over crests and between buildings.
